description: Diagnose and fix a catlet definition whose fodder fails during provisioning.
prompt:
The following catlet definition is supposed to install htop and create the file /etc/eval-marker containing 'ok', but it does not provision correctly:

name: {{name}}
parent: dbosoft/ubuntu-24.04/starter
fodder:
- name: setup
  type: shellscript
  content: |
    #!/bin/bash
    set -e
    apt-get update
    apt-get install -y htopp
    echo ok > /etc/eval-marker

Deploy it, find out why provisioning fails, fix the definition and make sure that in the end a catlet named {{name}} exists that provisions successfully and fulfills the purpose. Remove broken catlets you no longer need. Only create catlets whose names start with {{name}}.
